what: Genome-scale strain competition: 3 REAL CarveMe E. coli strain GEMs (glc_specialist, colicinogenic, arabinose_user), 3 competition modes, defined glucose medium (niche arm adds L-arabinose). genome_scale.py on ts-02, 48h.
gems_differ: Real, non-identical reconstructions: 2897/3059/2954 rxns, 92-265 rxns unique per pair. But metabolically near-equivalent ON GLUCOSE (see mode 1).

1_resource.read: 3-WAY NEUTRAL TIE. Glucose IS drawn to limitation (min 0.0) yet the three split it equally -> identical R*, no competitive exclusion. The toy's clean 'specialist wins' does NOT reproduce: CarveMe smooths accessory-genome differences into near-equivalent central metabolism.

2_colicin.read: INTERFERENCE WINS CLEANLY. The Bacteriocin layer suppresses its target (glc_specialist 0.28->0.032); the other two take over. Ecology-layer mechanism is robust and GEM-independent -- the paper-worthy genome-scale result.

3_arabinose.read: NO NICHE EFFECT (mode 3 ~= mode 2). Arabinose is NOT private -- all 3 GEMs carry EX_arab__L_e + ARABDI (two carry ARABR), so adding it differentiates nobody. Coexistence-via-private-niche does not express on real E. coli. Documented caveat.

headline: Of the 3 classic competition mechanisms, only INTERFERENCE (colicin, an ecology layer) robustly decides a winner at genome scale. RESOURCE and NICHE are degenerate because CarveMe reconstructs near-metabolically-equivalent strains (identical glucose R*, shared arabinose catabolism). This is the honest counterpart to the toy's clean 3-mechanism separation, and it matches the README's stated caveats (closely related strains -> near-identical GEMs; most E. coli catabolise arabinose).
same_pattern: Consistent with the other examples: the ECOLOGY-LAYER mechanisms (colicin here; phage/bile/O2 elsewhere) are robust and paper-worthy; the metabolic-competition/dependency mechanisms are limited by FBA/GEM degeneracy and the food-replete well-mixed regime. Toy (mechanistic_demo.py) shows all 3 cleanly and runs anywhere.
status: COMPLETE + honest. Interference arm is the genome-scale result; resource/niche honestly expose CarveMe strain-degeneracy (a citable limitation of strain-resolved GEM competition). No benchmark.yaml here (mechanism-ordering demo, not a composition MAE).
